passages.doc_title: The I Ching and Philip K. Dick's The Man in the High Castle
passages.passage_text:
My analysis of High Castle focuses on the oracle’s contribution to its
conceptual design, which marks the book, in my estimation, as a particularly
major text in modern literature. Despite the existence of some novels and
poetry that engage oracle-texts (chiefly the Tarot), Dick’s effort along these
lines was stylistically the most experimental of its period. The I Ching also
provided a philosophical foundation for the novel in the synchronistic notion
of simultaneity or “meaningful coincidence”
